title: SpaceX Starship Successfully Completes 13th Test Flight
subtitle: The company looks toward a future of catching rockets with mechanical arms after a perfect landing in the Indian Ocean.

summary.en: SpaceX recently completed the 13th test flight of its Starship rocket. The vehicle successfully traveled from Texas to the Indian Ocean and landed in one piece. This was a major improvement over previous tests that ended in fires. Engineers are now studying the heat shield to see how it handled the extreme temperatures of space travel. SpaceX plans to attempt to catch the next ship using large mechanical arms on the launch tower.
summary.zh: 太空探索科技公司近期完成了星艦火箭的第十三次測試飛行。載具成功從德州飛抵印度洋並完整降落。這比過去以起火告終的測試有了重大改進。工程師目前正在研究隔熱罩，以了解其如何應對太空旅行的極端溫度。太空探索科技公司計畫在下一次測試中，嘗試利用發射塔上的大型機械手臂捕捉載具。

paragraphs.en: SpaceX has achieved a major goal in its mission to build a reusable rocket. On Friday, the company successfully sent its 13th full-scale Starship vehicle on a test flight halfway around the world. The rocket launched from Starbase, Texas, and traveled for about an hour before landing in a remote part of the Indian Ocean. Unlike previous tests, where the ship often caught fire or broke apart upon hitting the water, this vehicle landed in one piece and remained floating.
paragraphs.zh: 太空探索科技公司 (SpaceX) 在打造可重複使用火箭的任務中達成了一項重大目標。週五，該公司成功將其第十三枚全尺寸星艦 (Starship) 載具送上環繞地球半圈的測試飛行。這枚火箭從德州的星際基地 (Starbase) 發射，飛行約一小時後降落在印度洋的偏遠海域。與過去測試時載具常在撞擊水面後起火或解體的情況不同，這次的載具完整降落並持續漂浮在海面上。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, this successful splashdown is a significant step forward for the Starship program. In the past, SpaceX officials expected the ships to be destroyed during water landings. This time, the ship stayed in good condition, allowing engineers to get a clear look at how the vehicle performed. The ship’s exterior is covered in more than 18,000 ceramic tiles designed to protect it from the intense heat of re-entering the atmosphere. During this flight, these tiles had to withstand temperatures as high as 2,600 degrees Fahrenheit, or about 1,430 degrees Celsius.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導，這次成功的落海是星艦計畫的一大進展。過去，太空探索科技公司的官員預期載具會在水上降落時損毀。這次載具保持良好狀態，讓工程師能清楚檢視其性能表現。載具外層覆蓋了超過一萬八千片陶瓷隔熱瓦，旨在保護它免受重返大氣層時的劇烈高溫影響。在這次飛行中，這些隔熱瓦必須承受高達華氏二千六百度，約攝氏一千四百三十度的高溫。

paragraphs.en: SpaceX engineers used drones to fly over the floating ship and inspect the heat shield. Dan Huot, a communications manager at SpaceX, explained that having an intact ship in the water is a "dream scenario" for the team. The ability to study the ship after flight is critical for improving the design. Because the company wants to eventually launch these rockets multiple times per day, the heat shield must be strong enough to survive the vibrations and extreme heat of space travel without needing to be replaced after every single trip.
paragraphs.zh: 太空探索科技公司的工程師利用無人機飛越漂浮的載具，以檢查隔熱罩。該公司的通訊經理丹·胡特 (Dan Huot) 解釋說，能有一艘完好的載具留在水面上，對團隊而言是「夢寐以求的情境」。能在飛行後研究載具，對於改進設計至關重要。由於該公司希望最終能達成每天多次發射這些火箭的目標，隔熱罩必須足夠堅固，才能在不需每次飛行後都更換的情況下，承受太空旅行的震動與極端高溫。

paragraphs.en: This test flight was the second time SpaceX used its newest version of the rocket, known as Starship Version 3. Standing at 408 feet tall, it remains the most powerful rocket in the world. Even after landing in the ocean, the ship continued to send data back to the team through the company’s Starlink satellite network. Cameras onboard showed that the six Raptor engines, which power the massive vehicle, appeared to be in good shape even as water touched the ship.
paragraphs.zh: 這次測試飛行是太空探索科技公司第二次使用其最新版本的火箭，即星艦第三代 (Starship Version 3)。它高達四百零八英尺，依然是世界上動力最強大的火箭。即使在降落海洋後，載具仍透過該公司的星鏈 (Starlink) 衛星網路持續回傳數據。機上攝影機顯示，為這台巨大載具提供動力的六具猛禽引擎 (Raptor engines)，即便在接觸海水時看起來狀況依然良好。

paragraphs.en: Because the ship survived the landing so well, SpaceX is now considering a bold new plan for the next test. Elon Musk, the founder and CEO of SpaceX, shared on the social media platform X that the company will likely try to catch the ship using mechanical arms on the launch tower. This process involves the rocket slowing down as it returns to the launch site, where the tower’s arms grab it mid-air. SpaceX has already successfully used this method with the Super Heavy booster, which is the larger part of the rocket system that helps push Starship into space.
paragraphs.zh: 由於載具在降落時表現優異，太空探索科技公司目前正考慮為下一次測試制定一項大膽的新計畫。太空探索科技公司的創辦人兼執行長伊隆·馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在社群媒體平台 X 上分享，公司很可能會嘗試利用發射塔上的機械手臂來捕捉載具。這個過程涉及火箭在返回發射場時減速，並由塔架手臂在半空中將其抓住。太空探索科技公司先前已成功對超級重型推進器 (Super Heavy booster) 採用此方法，這是該火箭系統中負責將星艦推向太空的較大部件。

paragraphs.en: If the next mission data review shows no major problems, the team will move forward with this "tower catch" attempt. While the current ship is designed for reuse, it is not meant to be used again after sitting in salt water. However, the data gathered from this flight will help the team refine the technology for future missions. The ability to catch the rocket at the launch site would be a game-changer, as it would make the process of preparing for the next flight much faster and cheaper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果下一次的任務數據審查未顯示重大問題，團隊將會推進這項「塔架捕捉」的嘗試。雖然目前的載具設計為可重複使用，但它並非為了在浸泡於鹹水後再次使用而設計。不過，從這次飛行中收集到的數據將有助於團隊精進未來任務的技術。若能在發射場捕捉火箭，將會是改變遊戲規則的關鍵，因為這能讓準備下一次飛行的過程變得更加快速且低廉。

paragraphs.en: This 13th flight serves as a clear sign that the Starship program is maturing. By moving from test flights that often ended in destruction to a controlled, intact landing, SpaceX has proven that its design is becoming more reliable. The focus now shifts to whether the company can successfully bring the ship back to the exact spot where it started. As engineers continue to analyze the data from the Indian Ocean, the dream of frequent, affordable travel to space seems closer than ever before.
paragraphs.zh: 這第十三次飛行明確顯示星艦計畫正趨於成熟。從過去常以毀損告終的測試飛行，轉變為受控且完整的降落，太空探索科技公司已證明其設計正變得更加可靠。現在的焦點轉向該公司是否能成功將載具帶回當初發射的精確位置。隨著工程師持續分析來自印度洋的數據，頻繁且負擔得起的太空旅行夢想，似乎比以往任何時候都更接近現實。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Used in the phrase 'in one piece' to mean undamaged or whole.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 完整地、未受損地（常用於 in one piece）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「碎片」或「一件」，這裡與 in one 搭配表示「完好無損」。文中：this vehicle landed in one piece and remained floating.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The physical condition or state of something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「形狀」，這裡指物體的健康或運作狀態。文中：Cameras onboard showed that the six Raptor engines, which power the massive vehicle, appeared to be in good shape even as water touched the ship.

keyTerms.definitionEn: An event, idea, or procedure that effects a significant shift in the current way of doing or thinking about something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 徹底改變局勢的人事物、關鍵轉折點。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 game（比賽）與 changer（改變者）組成，指能帶來革命性影響的創新。文中：The ability to catch the rocket at the launch site would be a game-changer, as it would make the process of preparing for the next flight much faster and cheaper.

quiz.question: What specific observation did SpaceX engineers make regarding the ship's condition after the 13th test flight?

options.A: The ceramic tiles were completely replaced after the flight.
options.B: The six Raptor engines appeared to be in good condition despite water contact.
options.C: The ship broke apart upon hitting the water as it did in previous tests.
options.D: The ship was unable to send data back to the team due to salt water damage.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，文中明確提到攝影機捕捉到的畫面顯示，儘管水接觸到了船體，六具 Raptor 引擎看起來狀況良好。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到熱盾需要改進以避免頻繁更換，而非已經更換；選項 C 錯誤，因為本文強調這次測試與以往不同，船體是完整降落的；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到船體在降落後仍透過 Starlink 網路持續傳輸數據。

quiz.question: Why does SpaceX want to catch the rocket using mechanical arms instead of landing it in the ocean?

options.A: Because the ocean environment is too dangerous for the engineers to inspect the ship.
options.B: Because the ship is currently too heavy to land safely on a solid surface.
options.C: Because salt water exposure prevents the ship from being reused for future flights.
options.D: Because the mechanical arms are the only way to protect the ceramic tiles from heat.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，文中提到雖然目前的船體是為了重複使用而設計，但它並不適合在浸泡過鹽水後再次使用。因此，若能透過發射塔的機械手臂直接攔截回收，就能避免船體接觸鹽水，進而讓準備下一次飛行的過程更快速且便宜。選項 A、B、D 皆未在文中提及，屬於過度推論或與事實不符。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'maturing' imply about the Starship program?

options.A: The program is becoming more reliable and moving toward consistent success.
options.B: The program has reached its final stage and will soon be discontinued.
options.C: The program is becoming more expensive as it grows in size.
options.D: The program is focusing on biological research rather than space travel.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「maturing」意指技術逐漸成熟、穩定。文章第七段提到從以往測試常以毀滅告終，轉變為受控且完整的降落，這證明了設計正變得更加可靠（reliable）。選項 B 錯誤，因為文章顯示計畫仍在進步；選項 C 與文章提到的「降低成本」目標相違背；選項 D 則與文章主題完全無關。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the Starship program?

options.A: SpaceX has successfully completed all necessary tests for commercial space travel.
options.B: The 13th test flight demonstrates significant progress toward the goal of reliable, reusable rockets.
options.C: The Starship program is struggling to overcome the technical challenges of heat shield design.
options.D: Elon Musk is planning to replace the current Starship version with a new design immediately.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。整篇文章的核心在於報導第 13 次測試飛行的成功，並指出這代表了 SpaceX 在實現可重複使用火箭目標上的重大進展。選項 A 過於誇大，測試仍在進行中；選項 C 只提到部分技術細節，而非全文主旨；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到的是 SpaceX 正在使用 Version 3 並計畫改進回收方式，而非立即替換設計。
